purpose: Carry an action through until its object is exhausted.
keywords: We discussed every aspect of the problems.
We used up all the food.
I have read all of that author’s books.
restrictions: Works with actions that can cover a complete set or extent.
mistake: It implies thorough completion, not simply doing something often.
